# 4dots

> 4dots shares notes, photos and files up to 1 GB with a four-digit code. Everything is encrypted in the sender's browser with AES-256-GCM before upload, so the server and storage only ever see ciphertext. There are no accounts. Drops expire after 10 minutes, an hour or a day, can burn after the first open, and can be deleted early.

How to use it: open https://4dots.app, write a note or add files, and press "Encrypt & get code". Share the four digits or the link. The recipient opens https://4dots.app, switches to Receive and types the code, or opens the link.

Four digits are quick to share and also quick to guess, so 4dots suits things that matter for minutes, not long-term secrets. Wrong codes are rate-limited per IP.

## Links

- [4dots](https://4dots.app/): the app
- [Source code](https://github.com/4dotsapp/4dots): MIT licensed, runs on Cloudflare Workers with nimbo.fun storage
- [Docs](https://github.com/4dotsapp/4dots/blob/main/docs/README.md): running, deploying, API and security model
